result.decision_rationale:
External staging still uses the containing directory’s timestamp to decide whether a receipt was present. A timestamp-preserving restore can admit a ZIP whose receipt would reject it. An unrelated file change can also reject a valid ZIP. The report-protection and compiler-binding corrections are verified.

## Continuation for Claude

Keep the correction in the external-package staging helper and its existing disposable fixture. Bind the receipt decision to the selected ZIP and adjacent receipt. Carry an observed receipt through validation and recheck an observed absence before accepting content-only staging. Preserve delete sharing and the canonical publication lock.

Exercise both outcomes in the fixture. A restored dirty pair must be refused even when its directory timestamp is preserved. An unchanged receiptless ZIP must qualify while an unrelated sibling changes. Run the configured gate within OWNER AMENDMENT 8’s limits. Revalidate the retained pair after cleanup, rebuilding it only if material inputs changed. The existing static audit remains applicable when the full DLL hash and MVID match.

acceptance_ids: OWNER AMENDMENT 8, R11-F2 external ZIP and receipt selection
findings.actual: The one receipt probe records false. After restoration, both ZIP identity checks succeed. DirectoryStampOf compares only the folder identity and last-write time, so an equal timestamp also passes. Line 136 then validates the private ZIP alone and returns external-content-inspected despite the restored receipt.
findings.blocking_rationale: Default staging can omit a dirty or mismatching receipt that would require rejection.
findings.expected: Default staging validates the receipt belonging to the selected pair or refuses the ambiguous read.
findings.requested_correction: Observe the adjacent receipt directly as part of selecting the ZIP. Carry its identity and bytes through the copy, and confirm an initially absent receipt is still absent before accepting receiptless staging.
findings.requested_evidence: Extend the existing dirty-pair fixture with a restore that preserves the containing directory’s original last-write time. Record the restored pair, equal directory stamps and default staging refusal. Retain the publisher rollback control.
findings.title: A restored external receipt can still be skipped when the folder timestamp matches
findings.trigger: An external ZIP and its receipt are away during the receipt probe and return to their original paths before the final check. The restore preserves the containing directory’s last-write time.

acceptance_ids: OWNER AMENDMENT 5, preserve independent ordinary external copies
OWNER AMENDMENT 8, R11-F2 stable receiptless-copy behavior
findings.actual: The new folder-stamp comparison throws on an entry change anywhere in the directory. Both Begin and Reinstall therefore refuse the selected ZIP even when its identity, bytes and receipt state remain stable.
findings.blocking_rationale: The correction makes supported external staging depend on unrelated activity in the caller’s folder.
findings.expected: An unchanged independent ZIP keeps its normal receipt-backed or content-only validation mode.
findings.requested_correction: Limit the stability decision to the selected ZIP and its adjacent receipt so other directory entries cannot invalidate the read.
findings.requested_evidence: Use the existing stable receiptless-copy control with an unrelated sibling created or renamed during the copy. Record successful external-content-inspected staging and the expected ZIP digest.
findings.title: An unrelated file change rejects a stable external ZIP
findings.trigger: Another download creates or renames a file in the same folder while the helper copies an independent mod ZIP.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: IdOrAbsent establishes identity or absence with one open, and WriteChecked receives that observation. Gate row 112 preserved both input hashes after receipt substitution. Row 108 wrote an ordinary distinct existing report successfully.

Gate row 177 proves refusal when the move changes the directory timestamp. The helper never rechecks the receipt after restoration. With the same directory identity and timestamp, the restored pair still reaches content-only validation.
OWNER AMENDMENT 8 explicitly defers diagnostic wording for an unchanged, exclusively locked report. The failed open occurs before truncation.

ReadAllBound checks each enumerated hard-link name against the identity of the handle supplying the bytes. Gate row 111 records the equal-count replacement, refusal and unchanged original pair. Row 185 confirms the delete-sharing reader allowed rollback to restore both files.

Inventory equality and the build fingerprint now include the parsed referencePath alongside the alias-bearing name. Gate row 201 records both actual compiler arguments for byte-identical DLLs, refusal under the changed binding and verified-current after restoring the literal path.

summary.delivered_behavior: Waking Rune declares UMM 0.31.1 and compiles against UnityModManager 0.31.1.0, Harmony12 1.2.0.1 and Harmony2 2.3.1.1. The packaged DLL matches the static audit. The report writer preserves the tested inputs, and frozen provenance detects the compiler alias change. External receipt selection remains the readiness blocker.
